name: Gerena (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and red within a yellow border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Gerena (a castle between trees on white within an inscribed bordure).
history: Municipal flag of Gerena; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Gerena arms — castle between trees on white within an inscribed bordure
